# omni_machine_class (Resource)

Manages an Omni machine class: a reusable machine selector that machine sets scale against. A class either matches existing machines by labels (`match_labels`) or asks an infrastructure provider to provision machines on demand (`auto_provision`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A machine class provisioned on demand by an infrastructure provider.
resource "omni_machine_class" "proxmox_worker" {
  name = "proxmox-worker"

  auto_provision = {
    provider_id = "proxmox"
    kernel_args = ["console=ttyS0"]

    provider_data = yamlencode({
      cores     = 8
      memory    = 16384
      disk_size = 100
    })

    # Talos META partition entries for the provisioned machines.
    meta_values = [
      { key = 10, value = "worker" },
    ]
  }
}

# A machine class matching existing machines by labels.
resource "omni_machine_class" "manual_pool" {
  name         = "manual-pool"
  match_labels = ["amd64"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The machine class name, referenced by machine sets. Immutable.

### Optional

- `auto_provision` (Attributes) Provision machines for the class on demand through an infrastructure provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_provision))
- `match_labels` (List of String) Label selector expressions matching existing machines into the class (e.g. `amd64`, `site = home`).

<a id="nestedatt--auto_provision"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_provision`

Required:

- `provider_id` (String) The infrastructure provider that provisions the machines (e.g. `proxmox`, `bare-metal`).

Optional:

- `grpc_tunnel` (Boolean) Configure Talos to tunnel SideroLink management traffic over HTTP/2 instead of WireGuard's UDP. Leave unset to inherit the Omni instance default. Only enable this when the network blocks UDP: the tunnel adds significant overhead.
- `kernel_args` (List of String) Extra kernel arguments for the provisioned machines.
- `meta_values` (Attributes List) Talos META partition entries written to the provisioned machines. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_provision--meta_values))
- `provider_data` (String) Provider-specific machine configuration, passed verbatim (usually YAML).

<a id="nestedatt--auto_provision--meta_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_provision.meta_values`

Required:

- `key` (Number) The META key (e.g. `0x0a` for the hostname).
- `value` (String) The META value.
